heard: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron Where Ayman and Sheshai lived with Talmai Descendants of Anak in the ancient land The cities were fortified and very large In the valley of Eshkol they cut a branch A single cluster of grapes on a pole between them Forty days they spent in the scouting Then they returned to the wilderness of past They even saw the descendants of Anakthir In our own eyes we seem like grasshoppers The land we traveled through devoured
